paragraph: We study the drawing of a thin viscous thread from a heated preform. When the draw ratio exceeds a critical value near 20.2, the steady state loses stability through a Hopf bifurcation and the radius of the fibre oscillates, a regime known as draw resonance. Writing the axial velocity as a base flow plus a small perturbation, we obtain a linear eigenvalue problem, whose spectrum we compute by Chebyshev collocation on 128 points. The leading mode depends only weakly on the capillary number; inertia and cooling, not surface tension, set the threshold.
